text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During lunch break, I spot Kawakami Princess looking incredibly drowsy.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ahh, it's no good. Why can't I defeat this sleepiness with my punches?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She continues to throw out punches, but they don't seem to have any effect. She must be very sleep deprived.
